module: Flowgraph node "Fade Sequence" (category once_f_duration, obsolete): chains fade to black, pause and fade from black via ui_fadeScreen.fadeSequence. Inputs: "startDuration" (0.75), "pauseDuration" (0), "endDuration" (0.75). Output "faded" (pulse when the screen is black). The code recommends Fade To Black + Fade From Black instead.
notes: C.todo: "Obsolete; use Fade To Black and Fade From Black nodes instead."

_executionStopped.desc: Resets the state and the faded pin.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets the state and the faded pin.

onScreenFadeState.desc: Hook: state 1 -> faded = true; state 3 -> finished.

state.desc: Screen fade state (1 = black reached, 3 = fade finished).

postInit.desc: Duration templates at 0.75 for startDuration and endDuration.

work.desc: Turns 'faded' into a pulse (reset to false on the next frame).

workOnce.desc: Starts the sequence with the three durations (defaults 1, 0, 1 if nil).
